title: Integration Bundle
description: T30.3 / ADR-028 — Declarative per-game integration bundle. Typed RAM variable map + scenario event definitions + ROM binding + savestate anchor. Private; never committed with real addresses. Model: gym-retro data.json + scenario.json, adapted for clean-room constraints (ADR-026 clause 4).

game_id.description: Canonical game identifier matching the source profile (e.g. 'gng').

mame_driver.description: MAME driver name (e.g. 'gngb'). Must match ADR-005 source profile.

rom_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the ROM zip. Binds this bundle to the specific ROM image used during address discovery.

savestate_path.description: Relative path to the private MAME savestate anchor (e.g. evidence/private/savestates/gng_controllable.sta). Optional — if absent, the boot plan is used instead.

variables.description: Typed RAM variable declarations. Each entry names a game quantity and its RAM address. Addresses come exclusively from community cheat databases (ADR-026 clause 1). This array is the private equivalent of gym-retro data.json.

address.description: RAM address (0x0000–0xFFFF). Sourced from community cheat DB only — never from ROM disassembly.

type.description: Read type: u8/u16 (unsigned), s8/s16 (signed). u16 reads two consecutive bytes little-endian.

encoding.description: Value encoding. binary = raw integer. bcd8/bcd16 = Binary Coded Decimal (common for scores).

entity.description: Entity this variable belongs to (e.g. 'player', 'enemy_slot_0'). Matches entity names in scenario.entities.

axis.description: Semantic axis of this variable within its entity.

source.description: Citation for the address origin (e.g. 'MAME cheat XML gngb 2024-03', 'forum post URL'). Required by ADR-026 clean-room contract.

scenario.description: Scenario definition: which entities to track and what events to emit from variable deltas. Equivalent to gym-retro scenario.json.

entities.description: Entity definitions. Each entity groups its variable names.

variables.description: Variable names (must match names in the top-level variables array).

active_flag_variable.description: Variable name whose non-zero value indicates this entity slot is active. Used to suppress ghost readings.

events.description: Event definitions. Each event fires when an operation over one or more variable deltas is true.

name.description: Event name emitted to the state timeline (e.g. 'player_died', 'level_complete').

op.description: Comparison operator applied to the variable delta or current value.

value.description: Literal comparison value (required for 'equals' and 'not_equals' ops).

notes.description: Free-form notes about this bundle (e.g. calibration session, known limitations).
